_readme: D2b: second held-out scenario set, written on 3 Oct 2026 BEFORE the Tier-1 changes and never used for tuning. Battery, Charging, Display, Performance, Connectivity, Camera, plus two mismatched article/complaint pairs that must abstain. Reference texts are the team's own writing in the style of the kit articles; gold deeplink ids come from starter_kit/Theme 2/deeplinks.json.

cases.query: my battery percentage keeps dropping even when I'm not using the phone

siis_response.title: Battery drains while the phone is idle
siis_response.content:
## Put unused apps to sleep
Apps running in the background use battery even when the screen is off. Go to Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, and then tap the switch next to Put unused apps to sleep.
## Turn on Adaptive battery
Adaptive battery learns how you use apps and limits battery for apps you rarely use. Go to Settings, tap Battery, tap More battery settings, and then tap the switch next to Adaptive battery.
## Use Power saving
Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap the switch next to Power saving.
## Contact Customer Support
If the battery still drains quickly when idle, contact Customer Support to have the battery checked.

expected_actions.name: Enable Put Unused Apps to Sleep

cases.query: wireless charging stopped working on my Nexa X1

siis_response.title: Wireless charging does not work
siis_response.content:
## Check the charging pad and case
Remove any metal case, magnets or cards from the back of the phone. Place the phone in the centre of the charging pad and make sure the pad is connected to its own adapter.
## Turn on Fast wireless charging
If charging is very slow, go to Settings, tap Battery, tap Charging settings, and then tap the switch next to Fast wireless charging.
## Restart your device
Press and hold the Side button, then tap Restart. Tap Restart again to confirm.

expected_actions.name: Check the Charging Pad and Case

cases.query: I can barely read my screen outside in sunlight even at max brightness

siis_response.title: Screen is hard to see in bright light
siis_response.content:
## Turn on Extra brightness
Extra brightness raises the maximum screen brightness for outdoor use. Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap the switch next to Extra brightness.
## Turn on Adaptive brightness
Adaptive brightness adjusts the screen to the light around you. Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap the switch next to Adaptive brightness.
## Clean the screen
Wipe the screen with a soft, dry microfiber cloth to remove smudges that reduce visibility.

cases.query: everything on my screen looks too small and hard to read

siis_response.title: Make text and items on the screen larger
siis_response.content:
## Change Screen zoom
Screen zoom makes everything on the screen larger, including icons and text. Go to Settings, tap Display, tap Screen zoom, and then drag the slider to the right.
## Use Bold font
Bold font makes text easier to read. Go to Settings, tap Display, tap Font size and style, and then tap the switch next to Bold font.

cases.query: my phone keeps restarting on its own at random times

siis_response.title: Phone restarts by itself
siis_response.content:
## Check Auto restart
The device can restart automatically to keep running smoothly. If unexpected restarts bother you, go to Settings, tap Device care, tap Auto optimization, and then tap the switch next to Auto restart to turn it off.
## Update the software
Go to Settings, tap Software update, and then tap Download and install.
## Use Safe mode
Press and hold the Side button, touch and hold Power off, and then tap Safe mode. If the restarts stop, a recently installed app may be the cause.

cases.query: my bluetooth earbuds won't connect to the phone anymore

siis_response.title: Bluetooth device does not connect
siis_response.content:
## Check Bluetooth
Go to Settings, tap Connections, and then tap Bluetooth. Make sure the switch is on and select your earbuds from the list of devices.
## Pair the device again
Forget the earbuds in the Bluetooth list, put the earbuds back in their case, and then pair them again.
## Restart your device
Press and hold the Side button, then tap Restart.

cases.query: the phone vibrates every time I take a photo, how do I stop it

siis_response.title: Turn off camera vibration
siis_response.content:
## Turn off Camera feedback
The device can vibrate when you take a picture. Go to Settings, tap Sounds and vibration, tap System sound and vibration control, and then tap the switch next to Camera feedback to turn it off.

cases.query: apps keep crashing and closing on my tablet

siis_response.title: Apps close unexpectedly
siis_response.content:
## Update the app
Open the app store, search for the app, and then tap Update.
## Clear the app cache
Navigate to Settings. Tap Apps. Select the app. Tap Storage. Tap Clear cache.
## Restart your device
Press and hold the Side button, then tap Restart.
